guarantees.claim: sp_enc_err_q is cleared to 0 when rst_ni is low.
sp_enc_err_q is set to 1 when sp_enc_err_d is high and not in reset.
sp_enc_err_q retains its previous value when sp_enc_err_d is low (after reset), making the error flag sticky until reset.

assumptions.claim: sp_enc_err_q can only be cleared by asserting rst_ni; there is no other clear mechanism in this logic.
assumptions.risk: If external logic expects to clear the error flag without a reset, the flag will remain stuck, potentially masking new errors or causing incorrect system behavior.

uncertain_points.claim: sp_enc_err_q lacks a dedicated clear signal; it is unknown whether the design intentionally requires a full reset to clear the error or if a software-clearable register is needed.
uncertain_points.risk: If the specification expects error clearing without system reset, this latch may cause a persistent error condition and hinder recovery.
